## About
- Role: Software Specialist at PTC (Nov 2025 - present); previously Software Engineer at Xoriant (Aug 2022 - Nov 2025)
- Current work: FMEA and CAPA modules for Windchill QMS

- Skills: Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, REST APIs, OpenSearch, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Angular, React
- Education: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, Walchand Institute of Technology, Solapur (CGPA 9.83)
